name: Hakuba (Japan)
description: A navy field charged at the centre with the Hakuba village emblem in white: an outlined ring of concentric lines with two mountain peaks at the upper fly.
history: Municipal flag of Hakuba, a village in Nagano Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The flag was adopted on 30 September 1956; the emblem dates from 21 October 1967.

features.role: Hakuba village emblem — an outlined ring of concentric lines with two mountain peaks at the upper fly
